2609.10464.title: Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization
2609.10464.paper_summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models learn a compact latent representation of the world that supports prediction and planning, but their capability to learn physics and generate physically realistic dynamics remains hitherto untested. In this work, we introduce SemiGroup-JEPA (SG-JEPA), which extends the LeWorldModel framework by supplying the parameter governing the physics to the temporal model via action-conditioning and jointly training an encoder and predictor through an autoregressive latent rollout. To evaluate the model's ability to generalize out of distribution, we design dynamical tasks under different gravitational fields that, despite obeying the same physical law, exhibit qualitatively different dynamics, ranging from floating motion in weak gravitational fields to rapid bouncing in strong ones. In contrast to DINO-WM, SG-JEPA reduces open-loop prediction error by up to 2 times on two-dimensional datasets, and increases control success rate up to 2.5 times for three-dimensional robotic datasets, for which we train independent diffusion policies. To explain this advantage, we develop a linear feature model that separates local law-conditioned error from its recursive amplification under rollout. Guided by this model, we find that back-propagating the multi-step rollout loss into the representation trains the encoder to keep the features that the predictor can carry forward, and that those are the features the dynamics depend on, so most of the gain comes from the encoder learning better features rather than from the predictor learning better dynamics. See project page at https://sg-jepa.github.io.
2609.10464.paper_summary_zh: 聯合嵌入預測架構（JEPA）世界模型學習了一種緊湊的潛在表示，支持預測和規劃，但其學習物理和生成物理現實動力學的能力至今尚未經過測試。在本研究中，我們介紹了半群-JEPA（SG-JEPA），它通過行為條件化將控制物理的參數提供給時間模型，並通過自回歸潛在展開共同訓練編碼器和預測器，擴展了LeWorldModel框架。為了評估模型在分佈外的泛化能力，我們設計了在不同重力場下的動態任務，這些任務儘管遵循相同的物理法則，但展現出質量上不同的動力學，從在弱重力場中的漂浮運動到在強重力場中的快速彈跳。與DINO-WM相比，SG-JEPA在二維數據集上將開環預測誤差降低了多達2倍，並在三維機器人數據集上將控制成功率提高了多達2.5倍，對於這些數據集，我們訓練了獨立的擴散策略。為了解釋這一優勢，我們開發了一種線性特徵模型，將局部法則條件下的誤差與其在展開過程中的遞歸放大分開。根據這一模型，我們發現將多步展開損失反向傳播到表示中，訓練編碼器保持預測器可以向前攜帶的特徵，而這些特徵是動力學所依賴的，因此大多數增益來自於編碼器學習更好的特徵，而不是預測器學習更好的動力學。請參見項目頁面 https://sg-jepa.github.io。
